# Justin Middler

Indigenous Australian Cyber Security Engineer and Software Engineer based in
Canberra, ACT. Almost 15 years in information technology and cyber security,
including more than a decade working in and alongside the Australian Public
Service since 2012. Former Microsoft Software Engineer contributing to Azure
control-plane services.

GitHub: https://github.com/jusso-dev
Site: https://jusso-dev.github.io/jussodev-portfolio/

## Capability

- Security Operations, Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Incident
  Response, GRC, Enterprise Architecture, C#/.NET development, DevOps,
  automated testing, and vulnerability management.
- Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Prisma Cloud,
  Cortex Cloud, SOAR, SIEM, threat hunting, and detection engineering.
- PSPF, ISM, Essential Eight, IRAP, ATO, NIST, OWASP Top 10, control mapping,
  secure SDLC, and security architecture.
- C#/.NET, PowerShell, TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Swift, Azure,
  AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Power BI, Azure DevOps, TFS, and Selenium.

## Certifications

- Microsoft Azure AZ-900
- CompTIA Security+
- Acunetix Web Vulnerability Scanning

## Experience

- Cloud Security Engineer, Department of Employment and Workplace Relations,
  2024 to 2026. Led Azure cloud-security uplift, Prisma Cloud and Cortex Cloud
  adoption, detection and hunting capability, compliance monitoring, and
  vulnerability management. Built C# and PowerShell pipelines processing
  hundreds of thousands of records into Power BI executive reporting.

- Cyber Security Engineer, Department of Employment and Workplace Relations,
  September 2022 to 2024. Led migration from a legacy SIEM to Microsoft
  Sentinel, implemented incident-response case management and SOAR, and
  engineered detections across Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint,
  Prisma Cloud, and Cortex Cloud. Built threat-intelligence ingestion and
  executive reporting. Mentored APS employees and contractors across Azure,
  AWS, cloud security, incident response, and security operations.

- Software Engineer, Microsoft Azure control plane, earlier career.
  Contributed C#/.NET production engineering to services supporting
  infrastructure used by hundreds of millions of people.

- Cyber Security Architect, Department of Education, Skills and Employment,
  January 2021 to August 2022. Advised major federal projects on secure SDLC,
  threat modelling, code review, OWASP Top 10, ISM, and PSPF. Delivered a
  secure container proof of concept and led AKS, OpenShift, and Tanzu
  architecture.

- Cyber Security Officer, Department of Education, Skills and Employment,
  September 2019 to January 2021. Advised cloud, hybrid, and on-premises
  programs; briefed the CISO and ITSA; contributed to policy and strategy; and
  coordinated with vendors, penetration testers, and IRAP assessors.

- Managing Director, DEUCEM Pty Ltd, February to December 2019. Led an
  Indigenous Australian startup specialising in software, mobile applications,
  machine learning, and cyber security.

- Security Software Engineer, NJOY Security, August 2018 to January 2019.
  Delivered full-stack and security automation, Azure automation, and IRAP and
  PSPF consulting. Helped prepare successful PROTECTED IRAP assessments for
  Google and Salesforce.

- Chatbot Software Developer, Department of Jobs and Small Business, September
  2017 to August 2018. Led the department's first AI help-desk chatbot using
  C#, Web API 2, Microsoft Bot Framework, Azure, microservices, and
  event-driven architecture.

- DevOps Engineer, Department of Jobs and Small Business, March 2017 to August
  2018. Implemented TFS and Azure DevOps delivery templates, PowerShell DSC
  deployment automation, Windows Server provisioning, and Dynatrace monitoring.

- Automation Testing Software Engineer, Department of Jobs and Small Business,
  September 2016 to August 2018. Established a centralised Selenium and Page
  Object Model framework and parallel testing through department-wide CI/CD.
